proposition.object:
## What are the current Kalshi odds?

Odds as of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC. Each price is the middle of the bid and the ask, read as a probability; the market lists 11 outcomes and 13 thousand contracts traded in the last 24 hours.

- **At least 7**: 2% (bid 1 cents, ask 2 cents; 5 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **At least 6**: 4% (bid 2 cents, ask 5 cents; 4 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **At least 8**: 2% (bid 1 cents, ask 2 cents; 2 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **At least 10**: 1% (bid 0 cents, ask 2 cents; 2 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **At least 5**: 100% (bid 99 cents, ask 100 cents; 858 contracts in 24 hours)
- **At least 15**: 1% (bid 0 cents, ask 1 cents; 103 contracts in 24 hours)
- **At least 9**: 2% (bid 1 cents, ask 2 cents; 35 contracts in 24 hours)
- **At least 1**: 100% (bid 99 cents, ask 100 cents; 0 contracts in 24 hours)

Prices change with every trade; the [live Kalshi market](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtrumpact/will-trump-do-anything-today/kxtrumpact-26sep27) is the current figure.

## What is our view?

We have no model of our own for this market, so the odds above are the traders' consensus and not an independent estimate. Politics markets quoted at 5 cents or less about 24 hours before close settled YES 4.9% of the time in our sample (41 markets; 95% interval 1.4% to 16%).

## How does this market resolve?

> If Donald Trump has taken at least 1 presidential actions from Sep 27, 2026 through Oct 3, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 4, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.

Close: October 4, 2026 at 14:00 UTC. Expected settlement: October 4, 2026 at 14:00 UTC. Settlement source: [the White House](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/). Full terms: [Kalshi contract terms](https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/POLITICALSTAT.pdf).

## What could move the odds?

- New polling, official announcements or filings, and statements by the named officials.
- The publication schedule of the named poll or tracker.
- A rules clarification or settlement-source change published by Kalshi on the market page.
- Order-book depth: thin books move on small orders, so a large price move on little volume says little.

## How reliable are markets like this one?

Across 119 settled Politics markets in our sample (Kalshi, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-03), the Kalshi mid-price about 24 hours before close had a Brier error of 0.0809; a coin-flip price scores 0.25 and lower is better. Contracts quoted at 5 cents or less settled YES 4.9% of the time (41 markets); contracts quoted at 95 cents or more settled YES 100.0% (8 markets). The sample covers a few weeks, so it is a guide to how markets like this have behaved, not a guarantee of how this one will settle.

## Frequently asked questions

### What are the odds on "How many presidential actions will Trump take this week? (9/27-10/3)"?

As of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC, Kalshi implies At least 6 at 4%, At least 7 at 2%, and At least 8 at 2%. These move with every trade; the live market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtrumpact/will-trump-do-anything-today/kxtrumpact-26sep27.

### What does a price on Kalshi mean as a probability?

A contract that pays $1 if the outcome happens and trades at 45 cents implies about a 45% chance, before fees and ignoring the small gap between the bid and the ask. We take the middle of the bid and the ask.

### When does this market close and settle?

It closes October 4, 2026 at 14:00 UTC and is expected to settle October 4, 2026 at 14:00 UTC, in about 18 hours from the time of writing.

### Where does the settlement data come from?

Kalshi names the White House (https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/) as the settlement source. The full contract terms are at https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/POLITICALSTAT.pdf.

### Can I bet on this on Kalshi?

Kalshi is a federally regulated exchange (a CFTC-designated contract market). Whether you can trade depends on your location and eligibility under Kalshi's terms. The market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxtrumpact/will-trump-do-anything-today/kxtrumpact-26sep27.

### Is this financial advice?

No. This wire reports a market's odds and its publisher's analysis from public information. Prediction-market contracts can lose their entire price.

object.primary: If Donald Trump has taken at least 1 presidential actions from Sep 27, 2026 through Oct 3, 2026 (as checked on the “Presidential Actions” page at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 4, 2026), then the market resolves to Yes.
object.secondary:
How this is resolved

The market solely resolves to the publication dates visibly displayed on the "Presidential Actions" tab at whitehouse.gov at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 4, 2026.
The week runs from Sep 27, 2026 through Oct 3, 2026.

Payout criteria

The actions may include proclamations, executive orders, nominations & appointments, and memoranda.
Any item listed on the page counts, regardless of its legal effect.

Examples (for Jan 10, 2026):

Executive Order with a Jan 7 signing date is released with a Jan 10 publication date → resolves Yes
Proclamation e-mailed to White House Press Pool but not uploaded by 10:00 AM next day → resolves No
Proclamation is released Jan 10 with a backdated Jan 9 publication date → resolves No
Bill signed into law and shows up on "Briefings & Statements" instead of "Presidential Actions" → resolves No
